title: 28:21 the Lord shall rise up as in mount Perazim/the valley of Gibeon. The Lord will rise up in his wrath to accomplish his judgments against the wicked, as he did anciently at Mount Perazim against the Philistines (2 Sam. 5:17-20) and in the valley of Gibeon against the Amorites (Josh. 10:6-14).
author: Tina M. Peterson
